# Titanium Security

> Premium Discord security and moderation platform — sub-20ms decisioning, defence-in-depth protection, and a luxurious operator dashboard.

Titanium Security protects Discord communities from raids, nukes, and abuse with a typed policy engine, real-time analytics, and an audit-grade logging pipeline. Built for the few who take community seriously.
